refnamediv.refpurpose: Fast Hartley transform of real input D

refsynopsisdiv.title: Syntax
refsynopsisdiv.synopsis: M = fht(D) M = fht(D, N) M = fht(D, N, DIM)

listitem.para: Number of elements of D to be used for the transform (optional).
Dimension along which the transform is to be computed (optional).

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: This function computes the Fast Hartley Transform (FHT) of the input signal `D`. If D is a matrix, the Hartley transform is calculated along the columns by default. If N is specified, the first N elements along the specified dimension are used for the transform. If DIM is specified, the transform is calculated along the specified dimension.
